instagram.caption:
The visitor rule.
The Safety and PPE Station in the Workshop. Make protective gear so easy to reach that putting it on is faster than skipping it.

What done looks like:
1. Safety glasses on hooks at the door you come in through, one labeled pair per regular user, hearing protection beside them, and dust masks in a dated box
2. An extinguisher mounted on the wall with its gauge in the green and clear floor in front of it, and a first aid kit that still has burn dressings and more than three plasters in it

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success safety and ppe station.
